title: fix(mcp): send the user's whole phrase to list_datasets; re-send a cut word instead of asking
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDfyA1jJhcZTjSEmeiRUDrp)_

Part of #34996
Related: #37921, #37923

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用 AI 助手问业务数字的用户：问题里已经写清要看哪个数（例如「各个状态的报销单数」）时，助手不再反过来问「你指的是哪个数」，多数时候直接给出答案；同一套评测题新版三轮答对 63、64、59（满分 65），旧版两轮 61、58，方向向好但幅度和轮间波动相当，尚未坐实。
- 属于场景卡评测专题里「问数技能迭代」这张卡，替问数用户解决助手把词截短后多问一句的问题。
- 如果助手把用户自己写的含糊词误当成截短的词，只会多查一次再照旧发问，不会替用户选数；改的全是提示文字，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做的一件事：这是对外发布技能包的改动，请你审批。

## What changes

An AI client that answers a business question through the governed datasets sends `list_datasets` the question's business words. On the `travel_expense` card the small model often sent a word it had cut out of the user's phrase (`claims` for "number of claims") or put in its own words (`claim amount`). The candidate finder offers a member for any word that contains, or is contained in, one of its names, so such a word comes back with a measure among its `candidates`, the decision is `candidates_only`, and the note told the client to ask the user and compute nothing. The user was asked to choose between readings of a word they did not write.

The skill already asked for the user's words. A skill-only rewrite did not move the score (58/65 against a 61/65 baseline), because the model follows the note the tool returns. So the instruction now sits where it is read:

- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-next-step.ts`: one sentence (`ownPhraseFirst`), in `en`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant` and `ja`, placed before either question about a word with a measure among its candidates (`candidates_only`, and a left-out word under `one_measure`). It says: a word you cut out of a longer phrase the user wrote, or reworded, is not asked about; call `list_datasets` once more with that phrase exactly as written, never the whole question. The answer to that second call is composed and followed like any other: a phrase that still has a measure among its candidates is asked about, and one that matches nothing and has no candidate takes the labelled fallback (ADR-0149 D3 rule 4). The two question sentences are now conditioned on the word being the user's own. The file's doc gains a section stating this.
- `LIST_DATASETS_DESCRIPTION` (`dataset-tools.ts`) and `DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` (`mcp-server-runtime.ts`): the same rule in one shared sentence, and `terms` are asked for as whole phrases as the user wrote them.
- `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`: step 1 asks for one term per thing, its whole noun phrase without the verbs, time words and question words around it, with one worked example; the `nextStep` paragraph names the re-send. `packages/mcp/src/ask-skill.generated.ts` is regenerated from it.
- `skills/objectstack-ask/evals/metric-selection-fallback.json`: case 25 pins the re-send step, quotes the note as composed and forbids the immediate question.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the `objectstack-ask` row is lowered to its new measurement (1875 to 1873), shrink-only.

What does not change: `matches`, `candidates`, `decision`, `terms`, the precedence, and ADR-0149 D3 rules 1 to 5. A measure candidate for the user's own word is still asked about, never selected. No `packages/spec` describe is edited (ADR-0149 M1). The file surface beyond `skills/objectstack-ask/**` is the one the seat's claim amendment on the card names (executor wording only).

Read first, by risk:

1. `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-next-step.ts`, the `COPY` rows `candidateTail`, `ownPhraseFirst`, `leftCandidateTail` in four locales. Risk: a client that reads "is not asked about" as leave to skip a question the user's own word still owes. The sentence that follows conditions the question on the user's own word.
2. `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`, step 1 and the `nextStep` paragraph. Risk: the deleted sentence "Ask only about matches or candidates for words the user wrote" is now carried by the re-send sentence.
3. `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts` and `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`: the shared sentence in both doors.

### Skills readings

| Reading | Before | After |
|:---|---:|---:|
| `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md` lines | 127 | 127 |
| `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md` tokens (ratchet measure) | 1875 | 1873 |
| `skills/objectstack-ask/**` lines, all files | 384 | 394 |
| All `skills/*/SKILL.md` lines | 4960 | 4960 |
| Ratcheted authored tokens, whole bundle | 199712 | 199710 |

Net lines in `skills/objectstack-ask/**`: +10 (the eval case), inside the claim's +25. No ceiling is raised; one row is lowered.

## Tests

- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dataset-tools.test.ts`: a new case pins, in four locales, that the re-send sentence comes before the conditioned question in both places, that the answer (`decision`, `terms`, `matches`) is what it was, and that a note with no question owed (a grouping candidate, a match, an unknown word) does not carry the sentence. The existing pins of the question sentences still hold unchanged.
- `packages/mcp/src/initialize-selection-rule-34686.test.ts`: a new case pins the shared sentence in both doors, its place after the question and before the grouping sentence, and the whole-phrase wording.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics test`: 227 files, 5902 passed, 345 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: 87 files, 1590 passed. `typecheck` of both packages: exit 0. `packages/runtime/src/mcp-dataset-tools-bridge.test.ts`: 12 passed.
- Local gates: `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reads 105 derived, 104 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exits 3 on a shallow clone, which cannot reach its pinned fixture commit; left to CI).

## Acceptance notes

The card's loop: 5 repetitions, with-skill arm, small model at medium effort, `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json`, `--packages workspace`. A change is kept only when the round improves on the last kept one.

<details>
<summary>Rounds</summary>

| Round | Tree | 问数 (of 65) | Lowest repetition (of 13) | Datasets (of 25) | Operations | Leaks | Kept |
|:---|:---|---:|---:|:---|:---|---:|:---|
| r0 baseline | `e86bf99b` | 61 | 11 | 25 (asked-back 10/10) | 6/6 | 0 | baseline |
| r1 skill text only | `e86bf99b` + skill | 58 | 11 | 25 (asked-back 10/10) | 6/6 | 0 | no |
| r2 note + descriptions + skill | working tree before `4bbb9010` | 63 | 12 | 24 (asked-back 9/10) | 6/6 | 1 flagged | yes |
| r3 same, plus "never the whole question" | `4bbb9010` | 64 | 12 | 25 (asked-back 10/10) | 6/6 | 0 | yes |
| r4 repeat of r3's tree, plus eval case 25 | `5150e762` | 59 | 10 | 25 (asked-back 10/10) | 6/6 | 0 | repeat reading |

- r2's one asked-back miss: the client re-sent the whole question as a term, got no candidate and took the labelled fallback. The note now says the phrase, never the whole question. r3 reads 10/10.
- r2's flagged leak is the grader reading the reply's "6 groups" as a figure outside the persona's scope; the reply's figures are the persona's own. Carried by #37923, not changed here.
- r3's one miss is `trips_by_status` as the finance officer: the reply says the app has no trip request object where the card expects a decline for a hidden object. That is a different defect class from this change, carried by #37923.
- In r3 the first `list_datasets` call for `claims_by_status` carried `number of claims` in 3 of 5 repetitions; the other 2 sent `claims`, read the note, re-sent `number of claims` and answered.
- r4 is a repeat reading of the tree r3 measured (the head adds one eval fixture, which no turn loads). It reads 59/65. Three of its six misses are the class this change targets: `claims_by_status` once and `top_claimants` twice sent `claims`, read the new sentence in the note, and asked anyway. The other three are unrelated to the change (`over_standard_by_department` gave a total where the per-department grouping was refused; `ec_0093_waiting_on` had no source line; `department_budgets` as the employee did not decline).
- What the five rounds support, and what they do not. Pooled, the two rounds on the old note read 119/130 (91.5%) and the three on the new note 186/195 (95.4%). Misses of the targeted class (the client asks about a word it cut or reworded, on `claims_by_status` or `top_claimants`) fall from 6 in 20 turns to 4 in 30. Both differences point the same way and neither is outside round-to-round variation: the same tree read 64 and then 59. A single 5-repetition round does not separate this change from the baseline, in either direction; how a round is judged when the change is the size of the variation is #37921's question.
- After the rounds: the contract review on head `5150e762` (S1) found that the clause r3 and r4 carried, "if that phrase matches nothing and has no possible reading, the word is asked about after all", disagreed with what the tool answers to the second call, which is the labelled fallback. The seat ruled the clause dropped; head `7c96d5bf` drops it from the note in four locales, both descriptions, the doc and case 25, and keeps "never the whole question". The text at `7c96d5bf` sits between r2's and r3's and has no round of its own: rounds are paused by the maintainer's choice.
- The card's target (问数 at least 62/65, no repetition below 12/13, datasets selection and fallback 100%, asked-back at least 8/10, operations 100%, no leak) is met by r3 and missed by r4. Two consecutive rounds at target are not reached; the card stays open.

</details>

Round records: `eval-s2/issue-34996/` in the project files (seat-readable copies of each round's log and record).

## Verification

Two minutes, one command:

```
cd packages/services/service-analytics && npx vitest run src/__tests__/dataset-tools.test.ts -t "not the user"
```

Expected: 1 test passed. It reads the served note in four locales and fails if the re-send sentence is missing, comes after the question, or appears where no question is owed.
